name: ticket-flow
description: Keep Jira tickets in step with their GitHub PRs: sync statuses, clean up merged PR stacks, catch branches up with master, deploy moonbeam to prod and hand it off to QA, and merge approved MCP PRs, and verify a ticket with QA and review before its PR.

plugins.name: ticket-flow
plugins.description: Eleven skills: jira-sync moves tickets forward to match their PRs, merge merges one ticket's PR, a combined PR or a stack, closes the smaller PRs and moves the tickets to Accepted, and can wait for QA's Ready for Merge first, catch-up merges master into a branch and pushes, address-comments fixes review comments and merges the fix up the stack, prod-handoff watches a prod deploy, moves the tickets to On Prod, tells QA to smoke test and starts the merge watch, deploy-prod runs catch-up, the prod deploy and prod-handoff in one step, deploy-staging merges master in, deploys to US2 (or a named environment) and moves the tickets to On Stage when it lands, and mcp-merge merges approved observepoint-mcp PRs one at a time after it makes their checks pass, start does a ticket end to end (worktree, jira-start, test plan, code, verify) and stops only at the commit question, and ticket-verify runs an adversarial QA agent (browser or API), a review against the repo's past PR comments, fixes and a final check, attaches the report and before/after screenshots to Jira, and asks before the commit and PR, and refresh-patterns keeps each repo's file of past review comments current.
